# wayscloud_regions (Data Source)

Fetches the list of available WAYSCloud regions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) List of available regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the region is currently available.
- `code` (String) Region code (e.g., `no`, `eu`).
- `country` (String) Country where the region is located.
- `name` (String) Region display name.
